## Change

Who needs this change, what outcome or decision does it support, and how can a reviewer verify it? Link related requirements, issues or PRs.

## Boundaries and compatibility

Record affected services, contracts, permissions, tenant/organization isolation, dependencies, data migrations and rollout or rollback implications. Link any decision or approved exception.

## Verification

List checks actually run, expected failure cases, and blocked or not-run checks with reasons. Distinguish fixture and live evidence.

- [ ] Reviewed the [engineering checklist](../docs/engineering/review-checklist.md) and [Definition of Done](../docs/engineering/agent-workflow.md#definition-of-done).
- [ ] Each contribution commit carries its contributor's [DCO sign-off](../CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-off-your-contributions).
